name: Yamaha TX750
engine: 743 cc air-cooled parallel twin, two carbs, balancer shafts
intro: Yamaha's early 750 twin with balancer shafts. Oil supply and the balancer chain are the known weak spots.

H: Oil starvation hurt many TX750s. Check the oil level often and look for updated oil-system parts before you ride it hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
